content: This medication does not prevent the transmission of genital herpes. To reduce the risk of transmitting herpes to your partner, avoid sexual contact during an outbreak or if you are experiencing symptoms. It is important to note that genital herpes can still be transmitted even in the absence of symptoms. Always use an effective barrier method, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during all sexual activities. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if it is clearly necessary. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk, and it may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Common side effects of this medication may include headache, nausea, and diarrhea. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefit to you outweighs the risk of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to penciclovir, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. This drug may rarely cause dizziness or drowsiness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate these effects. Do not drive, use machinery, or perform tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. This medication may contain lactose. For best results, start this medication at the first sign of an outbreak, as directed by your doctor. It works most effectively when the drug level in your body is maintained at a constant level. Take this medication at evenly spaced intervals and continue taking it until the full prescribed amount is finished.
